headline: Redemption?
caption:
Gable Steveson is reportedly getting his shot at redemption after that 12-second KO.
Statement win or another stumble? 👇

The Olympic gold medalist will reportedly face Terrance Chatman (5-2) at UFC 336 in Toronto on Jan. 30, per Bloody Elbow and Fightful. It would be his first fight since Sean Sharaf knocked him out in September.

🔥 Hot take: Steveson needs a finish here or the hype is done.
Disagree? Tell me why you're wrong.
question: Statement win or stumble?
